_comment: Copy this to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored because it holds your API key. You can also change all of this from the /setup page.
_engine: local = Whisper on this machine (private, free). gemini = Google cloud API (uploads your audio).
_gemini_api_key: Only needed when engine=gemini. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey . Keep it out of git.
_device: auto = use an NVIDIA GPU if present, else CPU. cpu = force CPU (same accuracy, slower).
_whisper_model: large-v3 recommended, on GPU or CPU. Smaller models silently translate Malay/English speech instead of transcribing it.
